simple.meaning: מְשׁוּגָה (mᵉshûwgâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “mistake.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Job, beginning at Job 19:4. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְשׁוּגָה (H4879) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: מְשׁוּגָה (mᵉshûwgâh) / H4879 is traced through Job 19:4 with source-language evidence and verse context.
